title: A workspace can have any number of scratch panes
body:
A workspace holds at most one scratch pane. `Workspace::scratch` in `decade/src/server/workspace.rs` is an `Option<Scratch>`, and `Workspace::toggle_scratch` replaces it. Marking a second pane as scratch unmarks the first, and the test `marking_a_pane_scratch_unmarks_the_one_before_it` pins that behaviour. The MCP tools assume the one pane too. `scratch.open`, `scratch.send` and `scratch.status` take no pane argument, and `scratch_launch` in `decade/src/server/compositor/channels.rs` reads the one name from `Workspace::scratch_pane`. The saved record in `decade/src/server/save.rs` stores `scratch: Option<String>`.

## Proposal

- Every pane the user marks as scratch stays marked. Marking one pane leaves the others alone, and there is no limit on the count.
- A scratch pane is known by the pane's own name. Pane names are already unique in a workspace (`unique_name`, `check_name`), and a renamed pane still answers to its former names (`Pane::answers_to` in `decade-ui/src/panes.rs`).
- `scratch.open`, `scratch.send` and `scratch.status` take the name of a scratch pane. A call whose name is missing or names no scratch pane fails, and the error lists the workspace's scratch panes.
- Every agent in the workspace can reach every scratch pane.
- Each scratch pane keeps its own `Scratch` state: the program last started, the call waiting on it, and its stderr.

## Rejected

- Numeric ids that only ever increase. They would keep an agent's references stable when a pane closes, but Jack judged that a renumbering mix-up costs one message to the agent, and names alone are simpler.

## Out of scope

- A mapping from agents to the scratch panes each may use. Jack runs one agent per workspace.
- Agents naming panes, in decade-9d0f2c.

## Cost

The saved workspace record changes from one optional name to a list. That bumps the format's version byte, and the reader keeps an arm for the old layout. The MCP tool arguments change, which moves `decade`'s minor version.

## Open

- Whether the name may be left out when the workspace has exactly one scratch pane, as the tools work today.
